# China Fire Tech (Safety Plus)

> > China Fire Tech is the online catalog of Safety Plus Industrial Co., Ltd, a Chinese manufacturer specializing in fire safety equipment including fire extinguishers, fire hoses, fire hydrants, and firefighting accessories with ISO, EN3, UL, and GB certifications.

Safety Plus manufactures a comprehensive range of fire protection products for industrial and commercial applications, including wheeled and portable fire extinguishers (dry powder, CO2, lithium battery types), rubber fire hoses compliant with international standards (ISO, GB 6246-2011, BS 6391), fire hydrants with various coupling systems (Storz, American, British), fire blankets, fire hose fittings, nozzles, and storage cabinets. The company serves global markets with factory-direct wholesale pricing.

## Key Topics

- Safety Plus Industrial Co., Ltd
- Fire extinguishers (dry powder, CO2, lithium battery)
- Fire hoses (rubber, canvas, UL listed)
- Fire hydrants (Storz, American, British couplings)
- EN3 certification
- ISO 9001 & GB 6246-2011 standards
- UL listed firefighting equipment
- Wheeled fire extinguishers
- Fire hose fittings and nozzles
- Fire blankets and fire safety accessories
- Factory direct wholesale
- Industrial fire protection
- Fire fighting tools cabinets
- Fire extinguisher balls (Elide)
- BS 6391-2009 & EN 14540-2004 compliance

- [10kg/25kg Cart CO2 Fire Extinguisher](https://www.chinafiretech.com/showroom/10kg-25kg-cart-co2-fire-extinguisher.html): Cart-mounted CO2 extinguishers 10kg/25kg, CE/EN3 certified alloy steel
